name: alpha-model-{DAY}
title: Alpha model {DAY}
subtitle: Walk-forward forecast of excess return per horizon (US $1B+), its out-of-sample record against baselines, the weights it learned from past-known days only, and volatility-scaled price bands. pred is percent excess against the market median: one order, never summed with rr / bo / left, never a buy list.

blocks.text: state: OK = out-of-sample IC with t >= 2 on non-overlapping periods and a positive recent IC; WEAK = positive but unproven; DEGRADED = positive overall, negative lately; FAILING = negative overall; NO_TRACK = under 10 scored days. Trust a horizon only when it is OK and beats the walk-forward baselines (ew_sign, best_single).

source.sql: SELECT horizon, state, oos_days, n_indep, ic_mean, ic_t_indep, ic_recent, spread, best_baseline, best_baseline_ic, beats_baselines, best_fixed, best_fixed_ic FROM state ORDER BY CAST(replace(horizon, 'd', '') AS INTEGER)

blocks.title: Out-of-sample record: model and baselines (ic_mean descending per horizon)

source.sql: SELECT horizon, method, n_days, n_indep, ic_mean, ic_t_indep, ic_t_nw, ic_h1, ic_h2, ic_recent, ic_pos, top, bottom, spread, top_hit FROM oos_summary ORDER BY CAST(replace(horizon, 'd', '') AS INTEGER), ic_mean DESC

blocks.title: Calibration: realized out-of-sample excess per forecast decile (u = excess / own volatility over the horizon)

source.sql: SELECT horizon, decile, n, fx_mean, fx_med, hit, u_q20, u_q50, u_q80 FROM deciles ORDER BY CAST(replace(horizon, 'd', '') AS INTEGER), decile

blocks.text: Bands b28d_q20 / q50 / q80 are the 20th / 50th / 80th percentile of the 28-day outcome for the name's forecast decile, scaled by its own volatility, in a flat market. move_28d is one standard deviation over the horizon in percent.

source.sql: SELECT symbol, ind, mcap_b, close, pred_28d, dec_28d, b28d_q20, b28d_q50, b28d_q80, move_28d, why_28d, pred_7d, last_surprise, dsp, dte, "left", rr, mix, book_usd, earn_date FROM live WHERE pred_28d IS NOT NULL AND mcap_b >= 2 ORDER BY pred_28d DESC LIMIT 40

blocks.title: Bottom forecasts, 28 days (pred_28d ascending): the model's laggards

source.sql: SELECT symbol, ind, mcap_b, close, pred_28d, dec_28d, b28d_q20, b28d_q50, b28d_q80, move_28d, why_28d, pred_7d, last_surprise, dsp, dte, "left", rr, mix, book_usd FROM live WHERE pred_28d IS NOT NULL AND mcap_b >= 2 ORDER BY pred_28d ASC LIMIT 30

SELECT symbol, ind, mcap_b, close, pred_7d, dec_7d, b7d_q20, b7d_q50, b7d_q80, move_7d, why_7d, pred_28d, last_surprise, dsp, dte, "left", rr, book_usd, earn_date FROM live WHERE pred_7d IS NOT NULL AND mcap_b >= 2 ORDER BY pred_7d DESC LIMIT 40

SELECT symbol, ind, mcap_b, close, pred_7d, dec_7d, b7d_q20, b7d_q50, b7d_q80, move_7d, why_7d, pred_28d, last_surprise, dsp, dte, book_usd FROM live WHERE pred_7d IS NOT NULL AND mcap_b >= 2 ORDER BY pred_7d ASC LIMIT 30

SELECT symbol, close, book_usd, book_vs_cost, pred_7d, dec_7d, pred_28d, dec_28d, b28d_q20, b28d_q50, b28d_q80, why_28d, last_surprise, dsp, dte, "left", mix FROM live WHERE book_usd IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pred_28d DESC

SELECT symbol, ind, close, pred_7d, dec_7d, b7d_q20, b7d_q80, pred_28d, dec_28d, b28d_q20, b28d_q50, b28d_q80, why_28d, last_surprise, dsp, dte, "left", earn_date FROM live ORDER BY pred_28d DESC LIMIT 60

blocks.title: Printing this week (earnings-week W0, pred_28d descending)

source.sql: SELECT symbol, ind, mcap_b, earn_date, slot, close, pred_28d, dec_28d, b28d_q20, b28d_q80, why_28d, pred_7d, last_surprise, "left", rr FROM live WHERE earn_week = 'W0' AND mcap_b >= 2 ORDER BY pred_28d DESC LIMIT 60

blocks.text: coef is the weight today's forecast uses: the feature's trailing rank IC from past-known days, age-decayed and shrunk by its own t (zero under select_t). coef_20d_ago shows how it moved; flips_60d counts sign changes over the last 60 fitted days.

source.sql: SELECT feature, family, coef, coef_raw, t, coef_20d_ago, flips_60d, cover_today, label FROM weights WHERE horizon = '28d' ORDER BY abs(coef) DESC, abs(t) DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT feature, family, coef, coef_raw, t, coef_20d_ago, flips_60d, cover_today, label FROM weights WHERE horizon = '7d' ORDER BY abs(coef) DESC, abs(t) DESC LIMIT 30

blocks.title: Weights in use, 1 day and 56 days (nonzero only)

source.sql: SELECT horizon, feature, family, coef, coef_raw, t, coef_20d_ago, flips_60d FROM weights WHERE horizon IN ('1d', '56d') AND coef <> 0 ORDER BY horizon, abs(coef) DESC

blocks.title: Live forecasts scored once their labels exist (empty until the first logged forecasts mature; grows daily)

source.sql: SELECT horizon, as_of, n, ic_pearson, top_fx, bottom_fx FROM live_track ORDER BY as_of DESC, horizon

blocks.title: Walk-forward record, last 30 scored days per horizon

source.sql: SELECT horizon, as_of, n, n_train, ic_model, ic_best_single, ic_ew_sign, top, bottom, top_hit, slope FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY horizon ORDER BY as_of DESC) AS k FROM oos_days) WHERE k <= 30 ORDER BY CAST(replace(horizon, 'd', '') AS INTEGER), as_of DESC
